title: How does a cricket call?
hook: An insect can make sound by moving two body parts.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The cricket scene highlights forewings, and the second panel shows one wing edge moving across a textured region on the other. Many crickets use wing structures this way; the toy drawing does not represent a specific species or frequency.

misconception: A cricket necessarily makes its call by rubbing hind legs together.
objective: In the cricket example, which surfaces are moved against each other to produce the illustrated call?
